# Function reference

#### `Connection::open_in_memory()`

Open an in-memory DuckDB connection.

#### `Connection::execute_batch(sql)`

Execute a batch of SQL statements (CREATE TABLE, INSERT, ...).

#### `Connection::prepare(sql)`

Prepare a SQL statement for repeated parameterized execution.

#### `Statement::query_row(params, row_mapper)`

Execute a prepared query and map the first result row.
